name: ヒスチジン血症

summary.text: Histidinemia is a rare metabolic disorder characterized by elevated histidine levels in blood, urine, and cerebrospinal fluid, generally with no clinical repercussions.
summary.evidence: Histidinemia is a rare metabolic disorde
